one_liner: Brex has a broad REST API with admin-generated user tokens for customers. Multi-user OAuth is partner-only. An official MCP server exists. The builder needs an approved Brex business account, and there is no customer sandbox.
auth_notes: Customers generate a scoped user token in Settings > Developer and send it as a Bearer header. OAuth 2.0 authorization code is for approved Brex partners, who receive a client ID and secret. Client credentials are used only for the onboarding API.
access_notes: The API is free for Brex customers, and a token is self-serve for an account admin. It requires an approved Brex business account, and there is no customer sandbox. The staging server is for approved partners only.
blocker_notes: The builder needs an approved Brex business account with admin rights to create a token. There is no public sandbox. Multi-user OAuth requires Brex partner approval.

evidence.quote: generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
For all other APIs, you will implement the Authorization Code Grant, which implements a web-based redirection flow to request permission from the Brex client to access their account.
This new open API is available to all Brex customers, free of charge.
Access needs an approved Brex business account, so an agent can't start without one. There is no customer sandbox, and the staging server is for approved partners only.
make a `GET` request to `https://api.brex.com/v2/users/me` with your language/tool of choice.
The server is hosted at `https://api.brex.com/mcp` and supports any MCP-compatible client.
